candidate_audits.name: Featherless
candidate_audits.notes: [The Grant] Featherless does not offer an ongoing free tier, recurring token allowance, or active free trial credits for developers. [The Output] Zero free tokens or API inference requests; requests are blocked when the account credit balance is zero or below. [The Process] Users must sign up and add an upfront payment method to purchase prepaid Developer credits (starting from $50/month or Pay-As-You-Go) or subscribe to the Chat plan ($25/month). [The Condition] API usage is strictly gated behind paid prepaid credits or an active monthly subscription with no $0 developer access.
candidate_audits.summary: Featherless is strictly paid-only, requiring a minimum $50/month prepaid Developer credit plan or $25/month Chat subscription with no free tier or trial credits.
